TASK-007.title: Prevent stale-task context refresh failures
TASK-007.summary: Make CodeWiki context refresh ignore closed or archived session-focus task ids and skip compaction when no source-backed resume packet exists.

goal.outcome: Context refresh after task closure no longer tries to resume missing/closed tasks or falls through to fragile generic summarization.
acceptance: Context refresh does not pass stale active session task ids as explicit resume requests.
Explicit stale task ids during context refresh degrade to open roadmap fallback or no-op skip instead of throwing Roadmap task not found/already closed.
Agent-end context refresh preflights CodeWiki summary and skips ctx.compact when no CodeWiki packet exists, avoiding generic summarizer fallback.
Smoke coverage proves stale active task handling and skip behavior.
non_goals: Do not change explicit /wiki-resume TASK-### error behavior.

SPRINT-001.title: CodeWiki vNext decision and graph workflow
SPRINT-001.outcome: Deliver the vNext operating model in bounded compatibility-safe increments, now prioritizing agent-owned session-boundary automation and workflow-efficiency friction reduction before decision_build implementation.
gates: Prioritize TASK-005 session-boundary automation/workflow-friction work before TASK-001 decision_build implementation until this accepted priority is resolved.
Keep current CodeWiki public behavior frozen except critical blocker fixes until vNext replacement flows validate.
Do not remove compatibility feedback/documentation/build/tool primitives before deprecation tests pass.
Each task must produce implementation_build and fresh validation evidence before close.
